description: Elected national president of Die Mitte by the party delegates in Bern on 28 June 2025, succeeding Gerhard Pfister. Stated he would continue the party's established course with a focus on continuity and stability.

organization: Die Mitte parliamentary group, Federal Assembly
description: Elected leader of The Centre's parliamentary group in the Federal Assembly, succeeding Andrea Gmuer-Schoenenberger.

role: Member of the National Council (Nationalrat) for canton Valais
description: Took the National Council seat vacated by Viola Amherd after her election to the Federal Council; sworn in on 4 March 2019. Sits on the Committee for Legal Affairs (RK-N) and the Committee for Economic Affairs and Taxation (WAK-N). Re-elected in 2019 and 2023.
Practising lawyer and notary, partner at the law firm Rieder.Pfammatter.Bregy in the Upper Valais.

role: Member of the municipal council (Gemeinderat) of Naters
description: Served on the municipal council of Naters from 2013 until his election to the National Council in 2019.

role: Member of the cantonal parliament (Grossrat), incl. CVP Oberwallis group leader
organization: Grand Council of the canton of Valais
description: Member of the Valais cantonal parliament from 2009 to 2018; served four years as parliamentary group leader (Fraktionschef) of the CVP Oberwallis.
